purpose: Prepare separately reviewed source contracts for diphoton heavy-flavour components or a common inclusive QCD multiplicity family. No physical production now.

syntax: define p4 = g u u~ d d~ s s~ c c~
generate p4 p4 > b b~ a a QCD=2 QED=2
process_proposals.mass_source: sm/restrict_default.dat: MB=4.7 GeV, MC=0; values observed in source, not adopted as a full PDF/mass contract
process_proposals.scope: bb component only; no inclusive total

syntax: define p5 = g u u~ d d~ s s~ c c~ b b~
define j5 = g u u~ d d~ s s~ c c~ b b~
generate p5 p5 > a a QCD=0 QED=2 @0
add process p5 p5 > a a j5 QCD=1 QED=2 @1
add process p5 p5 > a a j5 j5 QCD=2 QED=2 @2
process_proposals.order: LO QCD tree 0..2 parton family; not all diphoton channels
process_proposals.scope: Common tree multiplicity family proposal; loop-induced gg->aa/QED fragmentation outside present source family

pdf.requirement: Match active proton flavours, mass thresholds and alpha_s; verify actual installed PDF data files before new approval.

alpha_s.requirement: Do not assume ME PDF alpha_s equals tuned shower alpha_s; state and validate any intentional difference.

hard_scale.variation_protocol: Future reviewed central dynamical/fixed definition plus correlated and independent variations; match prescription-specific scale assignment; do not silently reuse fixed125.

mass_flavour_scheme.requirement: Model restriction, PDF, ME, shower and flavour-jet target must be mutually consistent.

matching.interface: MG5 LO Pythia8 generic interface exists; exact prescription not chosen

steps: Select one exact process/order/flavour prescription and IR-safe photon/jet target; freeze model/PDF/scale/shower.
Review generation-cut coverage and derive a finite scale grid from target hard scales, ME cuts and shower conventions; do not take numerical defaults as validated.
Obtain exact-source/card/hash and finite-envelope approval in a new output directory before even process/ME execution.

Within approved bounded events, compare per-multiplicity accepted cross sections, veto efficiencies, differential jet rates and inclusive/flavour-resolved shapes; retain correlated statistical errors.
Check generation-cut loosening, merging-scale variations, hard-tail support, HF histories, signed-weight normalization and repeat seeds; reject gaps, pathologies or unresolved closure.
A small bounded sample may be inconclusive; stop at cap and do not upgrade matching validity without sufficient evidence.

shower.QCD_g_to_bb_cc: Unfrozen; retain histories, do not veto to claim exclusivity.
shower.QED_radiation: Unfrozen; direct ME photons vs QED shower must have a defined scope, no invented subtraction.
shower.mpi_tune_hadronization: Unfrozen; include in later systematic/migration review.
shower.me_ps_interface_validation: Required; no new interface run in Phase10.

photon_cuts.requirement: Need common IR-safe generation coverage below reconstruction thresholds with cut-loosening study; no invented values.

photon_isolation.requirement: Smooth-cone direct-photon isolation fields verified in MG5 template; fragmentation/fixed-cone mapping and reconstructed isolation must be separately declared.

required: Full original LHE run/init/weight headers, integration uncertainty and event-normalization convention
Deterministic unique run/dataset/source-event IDs before any rejection; all attempted/accepted/written failure counters
Complete signed LHE nominal/variation weights and original source denominator
LHE to HepMC to reconstructed-object join, shower mother/daughter histories and HF births
Separate ME, shower, hadron, reconstructed-flavour and bit0 flags; preserve unknown ancestry
No event resampling counted as additional independent hard statistics

weight_contract.historical_context: Historical event_norm=average and IDWTUP=-4 need sigma/N scaling; neither copied blindly into new samples nor applied twice.
weight_contract.required: Read future LHE headers and actual ME/PS writer semantics; preserve signed sumW/sumW2 and integration uncertainty; for CKKW-L audit event x merging weight and accepted cross-section normalization per multiplicity.

output_scope.allowed_future_outputs: Only exact-source approved bounded LHE, accepted/rejected ledger, ancestry/HepMC and source-normalization diagnostics. Detector stage requires separate approval and scope.
output_scope.figures: LOCAL_DRAFT until separate exact path/hash/caption/provenance approval.

independent_review_checks: Review exact source/model/PDF/cards/hashes before approval; no invented human signoff.
Energy-momentum, mass-shell, source-event joins and signed-weight closure.
IR/collinear and flavour-jet applicability; gaps/double counting tested at generator level.
Physical scope separates direct continuum, fragmentation/radiation, detector fakes and missing orders.
Only separately signed/recorded reviewer evidence can count as external human approval.
failure_criteria: Any current physical production, nonzero Phase10 new-event counter or unapproved generator invocation.
Unknown PDF/mass/alpha_s, photon IR target, merging scale or multiplicity definition.
Invalid/incomplete/ambiguous ancestry or mismatched weights without quantified preservation.
Visible merging discontinuity or statistically unresolved normalization/stability; insufficient data is inconclusive.
Resource cap exhaustion, output collision, overwritten historical artifact, uncontrolled event rejection or unknown proposal density.
Any claim of a physical background total/significance/calibrated fake rate from this source-only contract.

resource_planning.ceiling_scope: All configurations combined; purely illustrative operational proposal, not authorization or implemented enforcement.

timing_estimate.historical_shower_only_scope: Phase6B bbgg/ccgg fixed existing LO LHE on earlier setup; excludes new ME/integration/matching veto/Delphes; not a forecast.
timing_estimate.estimation_limit: Disk arithmetic scales historical bbgg/ccgg compressed HepMC by 4 for bookkeeping/temporary copies only. Full new production size and integration CPU unknown; cap can stop inconclusively.

future_enforcement_requirements: Approve exact finite counters and cumulative CPU/wall/RAM/disk ceilings before a new source job.
Review a separate bounded enforcement design; this repository adds no dispatcher.
Stop rather than extend caps automatically.

precision_objectives.role: Feasibility and differential-rate/normalization sanity only, not precision production.
precision_objectives.condition: Per-process acceptance/weighted selected-rate precision must use actual pilot variance and independent N; no finite guaranteed N from zero support.
precision_objectives.final_selection_reference: Historical B01 28/1000, B02 1/1000, B03/B06 0/1000; a 1000-event total scan ceiling cannot certify all tails or target precision.
